scenarios.title: A｜正常推进
scenarios.setting: 在“汇报工作进度”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“正常推进”。

turns.prompt: 你想汇报项目当前的进展，会怎么说？

choices.text: It’s going well. I’m about halfway through.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s going well. I’m about halfway through.
feedback.explanation: “halfway through”表示进行到一半，能简洁交代当前进度。

choices.text: Pretty well. I’ve finished the first two sections.

feedback.naturalExpression: Pretty well. I’ve finished the first two sections.
feedback.explanation: 交代与当前有关的经历或已完成的事，让对方了解这次沟通的背景。

choices.text: I’m on track to finish it by tomorrow.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m on track to finish it by tomorrow.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: Most of the main work is done. I just need to make a few final changes.

feedback.naturalExpression: Most of the main work is done. I just need to make a few final changes.
feedback.explanation: “a few”表示少量，后接可数名词复数；比只说“一些”更偏向数量不多。

choices.text: I already finished half of it until now.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s going well. I’m about halfway through.
feedback.explanation: 表示到目前完成一半，用“so far”或“I’m halfway through”；“until now”容易暗示现在出现了变化。

turns.text: Great. Do you think you’ll still meet the deadline?

turns.prompt: 关于「汇报工作进度」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes, I should have it ready by tomorrow afternoon.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, I should have it ready by tomorrow afternoon.
feedback.explanation: “should have”谈过去时可表示本该这样做，适合反思或承认疏忽。

choices.text: Yeah, I’m still on schedule.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, I’m still on schedule.
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: I think so. I just need a couple more hours to finish it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think so. I just need a couple more hours to finish it.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

turns.text: Perfect. Send it over when it’s ready.

turns.prompt: 你想回应刚才的提议，确认接受或愿意配合，会怎么说？

choices.text: Will do.

feedback.naturalExpression: Will do.
feedback.explanation: “will do”简短表示会照办，适合接到明确任务后回应。

choices.text: Sure. I’ll send it as soon as I’m done.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. I’ll send it as soon as I’m done.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Sounds good. I’ll keep you updated.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sounds good. I’ll keep you updated.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: B｜任务延期
scenarios.setting: 玩家发现无法按原计划完成任务，需要主动告诉经理。

turns.text: Hey, I wanted to give you an update on the project.

turns.prompt: 你想说明自己担心的地方，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m afraid it’s taking a little longer than I expected.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m afraid it’s taking a little longer than I expected.
feedback.explanation: “than I expected”把实际结果与自己的预期作比较，能清楚说明差异。

choices.text: I don’t think I’ll be able to finish it by the original deadline.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think I’ll be able to finish it by the original deadline.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: I’ve made good progress, but I’m going to need a little more time.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve made good progress, but I’m going to need a little more time.
feedback.explanation: “I’m going to”说明计划或去向，能让对方知道接下来的安排。

choices.text: I wanted to let you know that I may be a few hours late with it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I wanted to let you know that I may be a few hours late with it.
feedback.explanation: “I wanted to”在提出请求或话题时常用于缓和语气，不一定只指过去的愿望。

choices.text: I can’t finish it on time because it’s too much work.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’m afraid it’s taking a little longer than I expected.
feedback.explanation: 说明工作量大是合理的；再提出可完成的时间或请确认优先级，能让团队调整安排。

turns.text: How much more time do you need?

turns.prompt: 关于「汇报工作进度」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: I should be able to finish it by tomorrow morning.

feedback.naturalExpression: I should be able to finish it by tomorrow morning.
feedback.explanation: “I should be able to”表示按目前判断可以做到，比绝对承诺保留一点余地。

choices.text: I think I need about three more hours.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I need about three more hours.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: Would it be okay if I sent it first thing tomorrow?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it be okay if I sent it first thing tomorrow?
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

choices.text: I can finish the main part today and send the rest tomorrow morning.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can finish the main part today and send the rest tomorrow morning.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

turns.text: Tomorrow morning should be fine, but I need it before ten.

turns.prompt: 关于「汇报工作进度」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Understood. I’ll make sure you have it before ten.

feedback.naturalExpression: Understood. I’ll make sure you have it before ten.
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

choices.text: Okay. I’ll prioritize it and send it as early as I can.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I’ll prioritize it and send it as early as I can.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Thanks. I’ll let you know immediately if anything else comes up.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I’ll let you know immediately if anything else comes up.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: C｜遇到阻碍
scenarios.setting: 在“汇报工作进度”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“遇到阻碍”。

turns.text: How’s everything going with your task?

turns.prompt: 你想说明工作遇到了阻碍，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’ve run into a problem that’s blocking my progress.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve run into a problem that’s blocking my progress.
feedback.explanation: “run into a problem”表示遇到问题，是说明工作受阻的常见搭配。

choices.text: I’m making progress, but I’m stuck on one part.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m making progress, but I’m stuck on one part.
feedback.explanation: “I’m making progress”说明事情正在推进，适合汇报工作而不声称已经完成。

choices.text: There’s an issue I need to resolve before I can continue.

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s an issue I need to resolve before I can continue.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: I’m waiting on some information from another team.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m waiting on some information from another team.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: I met a problem and can’t continue.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve run into a problem that’s blocking my progress.
feedback.explanation: 遇到问题常用“run into a problem”；“met a problem”有直译感，补充问题如何阻碍进度更便于求助。

turns.prompt: 你想解释影响进度的具体原因，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m still waiting for the updated files from the design team.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m still waiting for the updated files from the design team.
feedback.explanation: “still waiting”强调目前仍在等候，可以据此询问进度或预计时间。

choices.text: I don’t have access to the data I need yet.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t have access to the data I need yet.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: The latest version seems to be missing some information.

feedback.naturalExpression: The latest version seems to be missing some information.
feedback.explanation: “version”指版本，说明具体版本能避免双方使用不同文件。

choices.text: I need Morgan’s approval before I can move on to the next step.

feedback.naturalExpression: I need Morgan’s approval before I can move on to the next step.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

turns.prompt: 关于「汇报工作进度」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: Yes, I messaged them this morning, but I haven’t heard back yet.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, I messaged them this morning, but I haven’t heard back yet.
feedback.explanation: “this morning”明确是哪一天的时段，谈当前日期时前面不必加介词。

choices.text: Not yet. I’ll follow up with them now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Not yet. I’ll follow up with them now.
feedback.explanation: “follow up”表示跟进此前的事项；带上具体事项，对方就知道要查询哪次沟通。

choices.text: Yes. They said they’d send it over this afternoon.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. They said they’d send it over this afternoon.
feedback.explanation: “they said”引用前面说过的信息，便于核对约定或澄清说法。

choices.text: I was going to. Do you think I should contact Morgan directly?

feedback.naturalExpression: I was going to. Do you think I should contact Morgan directly?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

turns.text: Follow up with them again. If you don’t hear back by three, let me know.

turns.prompt: 关于「汇报工作进度」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Got it. I’ll follow up now and update you this afternoon.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. I’ll follow up now and update you this afternoon.
feedback.explanation: “follow up”表示跟进此前的事项；带上具体事项，对方就知道要查询哪次沟通。

choices.text: Okay. If I still don’t hear back by three, I’ll come back to you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. If I still don’t hear back by three, I’ll come back to you.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Sounds good. In the meantime, I’ll work on the parts I can finish.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sounds good. In the meantime, I’ll work on the parts I can finish.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。
